2.  **Admission Process:**
    *   **Application Form:** Jab admission process shuru ho, aapko KGMU ki official website se admission form download karna hoga ya unke admission office se prapt karna hoga.
    *   **Entrance Exam:** Aam taur par, paramedical courses ke liye KGMU ek entrance exam conduct karta hai. Aapko is exam ke liye taiyari karni hogi.
    *   **Counselling:** Entrance exam mein aapke rank ke basis par counselling hogi, jahan aapko course aur college ka seat allotment kiya jayega.

3.  **Important Links:**
    *   **KGMU Official Website:** [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org/)
    *   **Paramedical Admission Information:** Aapko website ke "Admissions" ya "Paramedical Courses" section mein latest information milegi. Wahan par admission instructions aur document checklist bhi uplabdh ho sakti hai.

*   **Admission Brochure:** Jab admission brochure release ho, use dhyan se padhein. Usmein saari zaroori jaankari mil jayegi.
*   **Contact KGMU:** Agar aapko koi bhi doubt ho, toh KGMU ke admission office ya paramedical faculty se contact karne mein sankoch na karein. Important contact numbers website par uplabdh hain.
